model_binding_evidence: Metric and alpha are paired from exactly the same archived fixed-step history row. Hash-verified frozen train.py observation() evaluates test and measure(measured_model) without any intervening optimizer update; original rows do not store per-row weights_sha256/spectral_weights_sha256. This is source/row evidence, not a cryptographic same-weight-hash check.
interpretation_caveats: One784x784 matrix is eligible; model-average alpha equals its ordinary fit.
Five-seed CIs are pointwise and marginal for each coordinate, not a joint95% confidence region or simultaneous trajectory band.
Repeated steps of the same seeds are correlated; pooling615 points as independent replicates is invalid.
Optimizer/configuration,training time,and alpha change together; trajectory association is not a causal alpha effect.
Held-out test is shown descriptively, not used to select a checkpoint or settings.
RMSE uses$100,000 target units; lower is better, and RMSE is not classification accuracy or percentage error.
